Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying legislative intent for gambling commission background information checks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to gambling commission background checks; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends that the gamblingcommission, in exercising its oversight pursuant to RCW 9.46.070(7),shall not require review of individual shareholders of corporationspublicly traded on a major exchange, including the New York stockexchange, American stock exchange, or NASDAQ national market, that areregulated by the United States securities and exchange commission andin full compliance therewith when said corporations are included in theownership structure of applications for licenses to operate amusementgames.
